context: Change the lint's falsifiability rule severity to advisory (warning, exit 0) while leaving other mechanical checks gating; document the posture in lint --help.
description: F1 of the 2026-08-05 adjudication. The falsifiability lint gates a field with a 7.6% execution rate (275 of 3,616 verification rungs have ever run; 3,341 have last_run null), and for pre-update-verb items its only remedy is drop+recreate — 24 open items are currently in that trap. A gate whose remedy is destroying the record is broken. Keep the check and its report; change its posture from hard failure to advisory warning. Pairs with expose-update-verb-in-project-wrapper, which provides the non-destructive remedy going forward.

preserves.behavior: Lint still detects and reports non-falsifiable rungs; only the exit-status posture of that one rule changes

verifications.expected: lint --help names the falsifiability rule as advisory
